plan.title: Reject past start time for single-stage RFQ

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Provide the mandatory event title so the schedule test is not blocked by an unrelated missing-title validation.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the requested product and quantity needed for a usable RFQ setup.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event configuration is otherwise valid.
Add the required QA vendor participant before testing the schedule.

args.goal: Open the Schedule Event drawer, choose Start later, set today's start time to one hour before the current time, press Save Schedule, and stop when the drawer shows the refusal for the past start time.

steps.note: The catalog has no fixed or relative argument for a past start time in the create-screen schedule drawer, so perform this dynamic interaction directly on screen.
Assert that saving the past start time is refused with the expected validation message.
